text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. As for Fine 
Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a food court! Pork buns, 
takoyaki... Everything looks so 
delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Mind if I check it out later? I'd love to 
go on a food crawl!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Why are you looking at the ground...? 
My, horseshoe tracks?! How fun~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is fascinated by everything 
she sees. Her curiosity is part of her 
charm, but right now, it's right before an 
important race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You're worried about me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It'll definitely be fine. After all, I 
just want to have fun!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"To enjoy something to the fullest, you 
have to give it your all, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I have only just begun to learn the true 
wonder of running with all my heart..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, running with everything I've got 
is just so much fun, and that's something 
I definitely know!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So there's no need to worry, I'll be fine. 
I'm going to run with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not used to this, but will this 
help put your mind at ease?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank goodness. Well then, shall we 
start getting dressed up now♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, aaah...! Incredible... I didn't 
know my heart could pound this hard.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, could Trainer be hearing this 
too?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Even though my heart's beating 
this fast...! Hehehe♪
choice_data_list: Be careful not to jump out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series... I shall thoroughly 
enjoy myself♪
